Artist: Lee Brice · Title: Drinking Class · Album: I Don't Dance · Year: 2014 · Genre: Country · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/COUNTRY/FILL/Lee Brice - Drinking Class.mp4
(born June 10, 1979) is a country music singer and songwriter, signed to Curb Records.
Brice has released five albums with the label: Love Like Crazy, Hard to Love, I Don't Dance, Lee Brice, and Hey World.

He has also released eighteen singles, of which eight have reached number one on Billboard Country Airplay: "A Woman Like You", "Hard to Love", "I Drive Your Truck", "I Don't Dance", "Rumor", "I Hope You're Happy Now", "One of Them Girls" and "Memory I Don't Mess With".
Lee Brice is the fourth studio album by American country music artist of the same name.
It was released on November 3, 2017, by Curb Records.

Content
Brice first announced the album in mid-2017, following the release of lead single "Boy".
